disclosures: Hypothetical results from rules applied to historical data, not a record of trading. Not financial advice.

Total return: dividends as adjusted by the price vendor, or credited in cash on the ex-date from ASX dividend notices where the vendor has not adjusted them (notices from 11 Sep 2024); franking excluded; vs S&P/ASX 200 Gross Total Return.

ASIC basis: Latest complete ASIC report published by each session (T+4 sessions on a calendar derived from the data; assumed for the whole history); values as later revised; original publications not kept.

Reference: The reference is built from the same price history with the same gaps. If a strategy beats the ASX 200 but not the reference, the edge may be the data rather than the rules. Gaps are uneven across stocks, so subtracting the reference does not remove survivorship bias.

Survivorship: Prices are missing for companies that delisted before about 2025. Heavily shorted companies that later failed are over-represented among them, so these results flatter the strategy, most in the earlier years; by how much cannot be measured.
Coverage is measured on ASIC-reported names only; the gap cannot be measured for companies that were never reported short.

recipe.asicData: Short positions: the latest complete ASIC report published by each session (T+4 sessions on a calendar derived from the data; assumed for the whole history); values as later revised; original publications not kept.
recipe.brokerage: Brokerage 10 bps per side, at least A$10 per fill.
recipe.capacity: Notional at most 5% of the 20-session dollar volume at the decision close.
recipe.cash: Idle cash earns the RBA cash rate.
recipe.delisting: A delisted stock exits at its last close.
recipe.dividends: Total return: dividends as adjusted by the price vendor, or credited in cash on the ex-date from ASX dividend notices where the vendor has not adjusted them (notices from 11 Sep 2024); franking excluded.
recipe.entry: Buys at the next session's open after the close on which a stock becomes triggered, when that session trades; otherwise the order is cancelled. After an exit, no re-entry for 10 sessions. Buys the session a stock first passes the template; Minervini waits for a volatility-contraction entry we do not detect.
exits: Stop loss: exits at a close at or below 8% under the entry price.
Exits at a close below the 50-day average.
Exits when the status falls to watch or none.
Rules are checked at each close in the order listed; the first to hit exits, filled at the next traded open.
A stock with no bar for 20 sessions exits at its last close.
recipe.preface: Execution recipe chosen by Shorted to test the screen; the author's own entries and exits differ.
recipe.sizing: Up to 10 positions, each 10% of equity at the decision close, taken in rank order: highest score first, then code ascending.
recipe.spread: Spread and impact per side by 20-session dollar volume at the decision close: A$20,000,000 and over at 5 bps; A$5,000,000 to under A$20,000,000 at 10 bps; A$1,000,000 to under A$5,000,000 at 25 bps; A$250,000 to under A$1,000,000 at 50 bps; under A$250,000 at 75 bps.
